widgets_values:
Bart's Model Selector: one node for any model file, whatever its format (safetensors, ckpt/pt, GGUF) and whichever model folder it lies in. Press "+ Choose a model...": a card for every file, filters by type (checkpoint / diffusion model / text encoder / VAE / CLIP vision), by model family and by format, a search by name or family, and the characteristics of the selected file (type, model, precision, parameters, size, metadata).
The outputs depend on the file: a checkpoint gives model + clip + vae, a diffusion model only the model, a text encoder the clip, a VAE the vae, a CLIP vision file the clip_vision (the others stay empty and are shown as (none)); `name` is the file's name. GGUF files need ComfyUI-GGUF or ComfyUI-SmartModelLoaders-MXD installed. Choose a model before running.
